premises.text: A significant portion of customers do not maximize their spending potential at local businesses
premises.evidence_span: 15% of their customers, people like me, represent about 50% of their revenue

premises.text: Traditional loyalty programs are inconvenient for customers
premises.evidence_span: But that's a pain for me to manage as a customer. I hate carrying them around.

premises.text: Existing mobile loyalty solutions require too much effort from customers
premises.evidence_span: A bunch of apps that sort of allow me to engage in the store, but they all suffer the same problem.

premises.text: Customers want personalized loyalty rewards based on their spending habits and interests
premises.evidence_span: they don't factor in how much I spend, what I'm interested in, and who I am

premises.text: Cardify allows customers to earn rewards effortlessly by swiping their credit cards
premises.evidence_span: I get points at these local places by simply swiping my credit card.

premises.text: Businesses can engage customers with personalized rewards and experiences
premises.evidence_span: they can identify me as their top customer and give me some special access

premises.text: Cardify provides real-time insights to businesses about their customers
premises.evidence_span: we show the business's real-time insights into how Cardify impacts their bottom line

premises.text: Distribution partnerships are essential for the success of Cardify
premises.evidence_span: the most disruptive products without distribution is nothing

value.text: Customers receive personalized rewards and experiences effortlessly
value.evidence_span: get VIP rewards and perks at your favorite places that are custom-tailored towards you

notes: Partnerships and distribution strategies are essential for scaling but are not separate premises.
